what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Colombia whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025 there were 2810778 people in this group, 46.5% of all Venezuelans in it worldwide.
Most Venezuelans in Colombia are counted in this group rather than as refugees.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group in Colombia start in 2018 at 1171552 and peak at 2851160 in 2023.
The largest change came between 2018 and 2019, and by 2025 the figure was slightly below its peak.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR, and UNHCR adds notes to some of the figures.
The figures have no breakdown by gender or age.
The sources don't say how people travelled or where in Colombia they live.
